content.title: The hidden tech inside your vape and sunglasses
content.description:
You can catch Trader Talk on Apple Podcasts, Spotify, YouTube, or wherever you get your podcasts.

AI isn’t just in your phone anymore; it’s in everything from vapes to sunglasses. On this clip from Trader Talk, Schwab (SCHW) Network Lead Market Technician Richard Ducat joins Kenny Polcari to break down how everyday gadgets reveal the booming demand for chips and rare earth materials. From Nvidia (NVDA) and Microsoft (MSFT) to niche players like CoreWeave (CRWV) and BigBear.ai (BBAI), Ducat explains why investors can’t afford to overlook the supply chain powering the AI revolution.

Watch more episodes of Trader Talk here.

Trader Talk with Kenny Polcari on Yahoo Finance delivers expert analysis and actionable insights, empowering you to navigate market volatility and secure your financial future.

This post was written by Langston Sessoms.
